projects.title: ClickDrobe
projects.description: A cross-platform Flutter app that turns clothing photos into structured wardrobe items using Gemini vision, enabling outfit planning, wear tracking, and personalized styling. An asynchronous PostgreSQL ingestion pipeline uses row-level locking and recovery sweeps, with garment processing consolidated by source photo. A Gemini-powered styling assistant provides 11 callable tools, parallel tool execution, and Server-Sent Events streaming for wardrobe search, weather-aware recommendations, and trip planning.
projects.outcome: 73% fewer processing-function calls in a measured workload. Thumbnail generation, JPEG compression, and migration of existing images reduced the payload for a 109-item wardrobe grid by approximately 99%, from 110 MB to 1 MB.

projects.title: LinkFlow
projects.description: A full-stack URL shortening platform built with TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, and React. It combines HTTP 302 redirects, click telemetry, real-time search filtering, and dynamic QR code generation. The multi-tier architecture uses multi-stage Docker builds, Docker Compose, and an Nginx reverse proxy, with automated testing and build verification in GitHub Actions.

projects.title: RAG Document Search
projects.category: AI System for Document Understanding & Search
projects.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for contextual document search, combining FAISS vector retrieval with Gemini Pro for answer generation. LangChain and Hugging Face models support semantic search, with backend APIs deployed through FastAPI for scalable access.

projects.title: AlgoView
projects.description: A browser-based teaching platform that visualizes 19 algorithms across five categories. Execution-state snapshots make a run fully scrubbable — play, pause, step backward — with pseudocode and complexity analysis staying in sync. A separate benchmarking engine runs the real sorting implementations in background workers across varying input sizes and plots the empirical runtime curve against the theoretical Big-O, all without blocking the interface.

experience.description: Mentored and supported 200+ graduate students across two semesters in Java, data structures, algorithms, and software architecture through code reviews, grading, and one-on-one debugging sessions.

Cut API latency by 20% (500ms → 400ms) on Spring Boot microservices serving up to 5,000 requests per minute through caching and load balancing. Automated build and deployment workflows with Docker and Jenkins, reducing the release cycle from four weeks to three across three microservices. Restructured SQL queries and added targeted indexes for enterprise simulation tools, cutting query execution time by 30% (1,000ms → 700ms).

Built and shipped a cross-platform inventory app (Flutter, Firestore) onto shop-floor devices, replacing paper-based stock logging and cutting processing errors by 50%. Real-time raw-materials tracking with Firestore sync reduced material wastage 42% — an estimated $15K a year. Automated reporting (Cloud Scheduler → Cloud Functions) produced daily consumption, wastage, and stock-valuation summaries as PDF/CSV, saving five hours a week of manual reconciliation.
